rules.study_timeline: Commission vote on each Petition to Contract, with no hearing or intervention; the Petition is deemed approved if the Commission does not vote within 90 days of its filing; Alabama Power should file the Petition and the Confidential Submission at least 120 days before the date the contract would become void for want of Commission approval; Alabama Power to use best efforts to answer Staff and Attorney General data requests within five business days (a commission review period, not a load study)

rules.contract_term: Longer contract lengths, from 5-year to 15-year contracts (the Commission's news release of 23 January 2025); the Rules pages print no term figure (A1: "a longer term of contract")
rules.exit_fee: D14 as held (on termination the customer may be required to pay the costs the Company incurred to serve it); added by the Staff and Company joint statement of 26 August 2026: the Company files a letter with the Commission within 15 days of receiving a termination notice, and will not seek to recover from Non-Large Load customers any Incremental Cost Revenue Deficiency for the remaining term, that deficiency being reduced by the termination payments collected or owed
rules.study_timeline: No load or engineering study duration published; the Commission's review step: each new data center contract is provided to the PSC at least 30 days before execution

queue_totals.figure: Committed large load (Contracts for Electric Service plus Requests for Service): 12,400 MW across 31 customers as of 31 March 2026, plus 3,200 MW of commitments added in April 2026 not included; large load economic development pipeline 73,100 MW of a 76,200 MW total pipeline through the mid-2030s; near term (winter 2028/2029) large load pipeline 23,600 MW (Q1 2026 report filed 15 May 2026, Docket 55378)
